tool_args.rationale: Five measurements vary essentially only u_now, showing a smooth monotone-concave response but leaving plausible saturation mechanisms observationally similar. Since the forecast horizon is not especially long, the main ambiguity is the untested open branch; the targeted open-branch probe is the lowest-cost discriminating observation.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a Haldane self-inhibition fit now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed range is only increasing and concave; it does not identify whether the downturn lies beyond the sampled range, and the branch/wide-escape behavior remains unresolved.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a Cobb-Douglas power-law fit now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: With only u_now varied and s_grad nearly fixed, its exponents and any branch response are not separately identifiable.
Repeated resolution along the existing narrow input sweep is less discriminating than probing the unresolved open branch.
It is explicitly nuisance data and does not resolve the candidate-law ambiguity.
